subject: Ramses II
hook: RAMSES II IS NOT WHO YOU THINK
angle: Ramses the Great is not what you think: the most powerful pharaoh in Egyptian history is still being found in the most unlikely places—like buried directly under a modern farmer's cucumber greenhouse. Recent excavations uncovered a colossal statue of the king estimated to be 28 feet tall after a farmer noticed an ancient stone while tending his vegetables.
angle_support: An Egyptian farmer's chance discovery while tending cucumbers led archaeologists to uncover two colossal royal statues, including one identified as Ramses II, whose original height may have reached nearly 28 feet.
Based on the size of the head, officials think the full statue, including the base, may have stood nearly 28 feet tall.

title: The Pharaoh Found Under a Greenhouse
description: While you might think all the great Egyptian discoveries are in the desert, Ramses the Great was recently found in a vegetable patch. A farmer in the Nile Delta discovered a massive 28-foot statue right beneath his crops.
narration: RAMSES II IS NOT WHO YOU THINK You imagine him ruling a vast empire from a golden throne or resting inside a massive desert monument. You think his story is finished and the map of his reign is complete. But he is still being found. Recently, a farmer in the Nile Delta noticed a carved rose-colored granite slab while working his vegetable crops. Beneath his modern cucumber greenhouse, archaeologists unearthed a colossal statue that likely stood twenty-eight feet tall when whole. The most powerful king in history was hiding under a salad.
